nodes.Name: common
nodes.DocComment: common holds the information shared by related templates.

Fields.Name: tmpl
Fields.DocComment: Map from name to defined templates.

nodes.Name: Template
nodes.DocComment:
Template is the representation of a parsed template. The *parse.Tree
field is exported only for use by [html/template] and should be treated
as unexported by all other clients.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment: New allocates a new, undefined template with the given name.

nodes.Name: Name
nodes.DocComment: Name returns the name of the template.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New allocates a new, undefined template associated with the given one and with the same
delimiters. The association, which is transitive, allows one template to
invoke another with a {{template}} action.

Because associated templates share underlying data, template construction
cannot be done safely in parallel. Once the templates are constructed, they
can be executed in parallel.

nodes.Name: init
nodes.DocComment: init guarantees that t has a valid common structure.

nodes.Name: Clone
nodes.DocComment:
Clone returns a duplicate of the template, including all associated
templates. The actual representation is not copied, but the name space of
associated templates is, so further calls to [Template.Parse] in the copy will add
templates to the copy but not to the original. Clone can be used to prepare
common templates and use them with variant definitions for other templates
by adding the variants after the clone is made.

nodes.Name: copy
nodes.DocComment: copy returns a shallow copy of t, with common set to the argument.

nodes.Name: AddParseTree
nodes.DocComment:
AddParseTree associates the argument parse tree with the template t, giving
it the specified name. If the template has not been defined, this tree becomes
its definition. If it has been defined and already has that name, the existing
definition is replaced; otherwise a new template is created, defined, and returned.

nodes.Name: Templates
nodes.DocComment: Templates returns a slice of defined templates associated with t.

nodes.Name: Delims
nodes.DocComment:
Delims sets the action delimiters to the specified strings, to be used in
subsequent calls to [Template.Parse], [Template.ParseFiles], or [Template.ParseGlob]. Nested template
definitions will inherit the settings. An empty delimiter stands for the
corresponding default: {{ or }}.
The return value is the template, so calls can be chained.

nodes.Name: Funcs
nodes.DocComment:
Funcs adds the elements of the argument map to the template's function map.
It must be called before the template is parsed.
It panics if a value in the map is not a function with appropriate return
type or if the name cannot be used syntactically as a function in a template.
It is legal to overwrite elements of the map. The return value is the template,
so calls can be chained.

nodes.Name: Lookup
nodes.DocComment:
Lookup returns the template with the given name that is associated with t.
It returns nil if there is no such template or the template has no definition.

nodes.Name: Parse
nodes.DocComment:
Parse parses text as a template body for t.
Named template definitions ({{define ...}} or {{block ...}} statements) in text
define additional templates associated with t and are removed from the
definition of t itself.

Templates can be redefined in successive calls to Parse.
A template definition with a body containing only white space and comments
is considered empty and will not replace an existing template's body.
This allows using Parse to add new named template definitions without
overwriting the main template body.

nodes.Name: associate
nodes.DocComment:
associate installs the new template into the group of templates associated
with t. The two are already known to share the common structure.
The boolean return value reports whether to store this tree as t.Tree.
